svg.title: Shadowy — Kategorija × Klients
svg.desc: A purple and indigo tablet on textured fabric, with the supplied Shadowy matrix as an opaque vector display. All 13 visible client columns and readable values are reproduced. The final row label is partially cropped in the supplied screenshot and is marked with an ellipsis; two additional clients mentioned in the source are outside its visible area. Display elements, text and values are vector paths. The photorealistic tablet and fabric are an embedded raster image. Output has a standard 16:9 aspect ratio and no external dependencies.

path.aria-label: Kurš klients dod visvairāk katras kategorijas darba tieši tev. · 15 klientus
